turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Maya, an AI assistant at Northgate Lettings. How can I help?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, I have a viewing on Tuesday at five but I can't make it anymore.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem. Can I take your name so I can find the booking?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks Sam, I can see Tuesday at five at Elm Road. When would you like to move it to?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Is Wednesday at five any good?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Wednesday at five is free. I've moved your viewing there and cancelled Tuesday. You'll get a new confirmation text.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome Sam, see you Wednesday.
